character: giant leech, glossy dark olive, amber stripe, boneless waves, never vertical; a wide lipped mouth for speech only, eyes above it; her suckers are on her underside, never on her head
props: three thick pink rubber tubes plugged into her belly suckers, a white tag on each; they stay plugged in all clip and lash after her; one red crab with big scissors at the lens, a tag on his claw reading ОТПИСКА, snapping and missing
motion_rule: every window she crosses the frame and lands somewhere new, tubes lashing after her; she never speaks from one spot; camera moves and shot size changes every window; the crab large in front
environment: sunlit shallows at noon, a long ridge of flat stones running from the lens into the water, hard shadows

audio.delivery: smug oily female voice, native Russian stress, greedy and bossy, biting off each word
audio.pronunciation: доноры is do-NO-ry; отрывать is ot-ry-VAT
audio.lip_sync: her lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: she rips off the near stone with a pop and flies at the lens; the crab lunges at us
she bounds three stones left to right, spray bursting, tubes whipping; the crab gallops at the lens
timeline.c: low, tracks her past the stones

timeline.a: she circles the crab, body waving, tubes dragging a fan of spray; he spins after her
timeline.c: close, orbits her the other way

timeline.a: the tubes snap taut at once and she charges away down the ridge
she pours over three stones at the lens, tubes bulging; the crab backs off huge in front
she rolls sideways along the ridge like a barrel, tubes winding round her; the crab jumps after
timeline.c: top down, slides along the ridge

timeline.a: she dives in and surfaces two stones on in a sheet of spray; the crab shoves the ОТПИСКА tag at us
she rears out of the water and swings her body across the lens, tubes fanning; the crab swings and misses
she charges the lens down the ridge, the tubes ripping a wake
she swells triple and rams the lens head first, mouth wide and clear; the crab saws at the glass
she balls up and springs sideways over the crab, landing two stones on; the scissors fly
she gallops the ridge in waves, tubes stretching to threads; the crab dragged along on one
she throws herself into the water and bursts back out through the spray; the crab is spun round
fresh tubes snap onto her belly, pink running in jerks, she swells off the stones; a tag flies at the lens unrolling ПОДПИСКА in black capitals

must_appear: pink tubes plugged into her belly all clip, never at her mouth; the last frame is the ПОДПИСКА tag filling the frame
negative_prompt: a vertical pillar in one place, only her head moving, speaking from one stone, a tube at her mouth or lips, sleepy eyes, a belly with no tubes on it, a tube cut loose, static camera, same shot size twice, night, dark scene, a talking head, garbled words, Latin letters on the tags, two crabs, subtitles, watermark, English speech, any word after 6.35
